## Feature 6: Persistence, Save/Load Migration, Tutorial, Docs, Full Suite

### Summary
Wire `week`/`year` into save/load with legacy migration (default to week=1, year=1 for old saves), record in transcript, update tutorial text, update documentation, and run the full test suite.

### Acceptance Criteria
1. `serializeMainStreetState` includes `week` and `year` in the serialized state.
2. `deserializeMainStreetState` migrates legacy saves (defaults to `week=1, year=1` when absent).
3. Save/load round-trip test verifies week/year persistence and migration.
4. Week and year are recorded in transcript events (via `TranscriptRecorderBase<T>`).
5. Tutorial text reconciled with the week model (HUD and help text no longer contradict "1 turn = 1 week").
6. `docs/main-street/card-catalog.md` updated with new cards, windows, and audit table for all 56 existing events.
7. Full test suite passes (`npm test` green at the commit under review).
8. `npm run build` succeeds.

### Key Files
- `example-games/main-street/MainStreetState.ts` - Save/load serialization, legacy migration
- `tests/main-street/CalendarSaveLoad.test.ts` - Round-trip and migration tests
- `docs/main-street/card-catalog.md` - Updated documentation
- `example-games/main-street/TutorialFlow.ts` - Tutorial text reconciliation

### Dependencies
- All previous features (1-5) must be complete
data.title: Wire week/year through save/load with legacy migration, tutorial reconciliation, and full-suite green
